sources.what: "Decks" section of each boss page (wikitext); card names resolved to dbfId through each linked card page's |dbfId= on hearthstone.wiki.gg, then to card ids via Server/data/dbf-36.6.0.0-20261004/Card.json
fandom copy (live fandom blocks fetch): same "Possible cards" table, no counts
strategy prose only, names a few deck cards, no decklists

legend.deckStatus: full = wiki lists every card with Quantity (sums to 30); pool-only = wiki lists only the boss's "Possible cards" (no counts, count=null) plus the deck size per level ("Total cards"); the real per-card counts were not found on any source
